10 استباحهُ He deemed it, or esteemed it, to be allowed, allowable, free, or lawful; namely, the property of another: (A:) or he took it as allowed, allowable, &c. (A, * MF.) See 4. ―
-b2- He took it as spoil, or plunder. (TA.) ―
-b3- He made an attack upon it; namely, the property of another. (Msb.) ―
-b4- He took him captive, making him as a lawful possession to him. (TA.) ―
-b5- And اِسْتَبَاحَهُمْ, (K,) or اِسْتَبَاحُوهُمْ, (S,) He, or they, extirpated, or exterminated, them. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
